decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The approved roof lights in the northern roof slope shall be non opening and permanently retained as such.

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposals would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the wider area and would not cause harm to neighbours' living conditions in accordance with adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities, c.1.2 (New Religious Meeting Places, C.1.4 (New Social and Community Facilities), C.4.3 (Physical Access to Social and Community Facilities), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments, of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: The erection of a ground floor and first floor extension (first floor within roof space) on the eastern end of the building, a ground floor extension on the southern elevation to create a new entrance, a revised internal layout, installation of roof lights, and alterations to the southern and northern elevations.
